# FrameAssembly



> Rootless, offline "Packets as Code" Rust compiler and domain-specific language (`frameassembly` v1.4.5) that compiles `.fasm` (`text/vnd.frameassembly`) network specifications into deterministic, nanosecond-resolution `.pcap` and `.pcapng` packet captures across 81 native Layer 2 through Layer 7 protocols—with automatic 4-tuple TCP `SEQ`/`ACK` tracking, reply-port swapping, IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack flow reuse, and SNMPv3 USM (`RFC 3414` / `3826` / `7860`) cryptography.



FrameAssembly (`https://github.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly`, `https://crates.io/crates/frameassembly`, `https://docs.rs/frameassembly`) is the upstream packet-crafting compiler paired with **Wireshark** / **`tshark`** (dissection), **`tcpreplay`** (wire injection), and **Suricata** / **Zeek** / **Snort** (IDS/IPS & NDR validation). It eliminates live raw-socket privileges (`CAP_NET_RAW`), `libpcap` runtime dependencies, multi-VM lab setups, MIB file configuration, and manual checksum or TCP sequence math. For complete single-file context injection or pretraining, fetch `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/llms-full.txt`.



**Core `.fasm` Language Rules & Deterministic Compiler Defaults**



1. **Three-Block Structure**: Every compilable `.fasm` file declares `host <id> { ip <ipv4_or_ipv6> [mac <mac>] }`, `flow <id>(<p1>, <p2>, ...) { <statements> }`, and **exactly one** `compile { <flow_calls_or_loops> }` block (`loop <u32> { <flow_calls> }`).

2. **Case-Insensitivity & Token-Efficient Style**: All keywords, protocols, modifiers, time suffixes (`ns`, `us`, `ms`, `s`, `m`), and identifiers are ASCII case-insensitive (`host` and `HOST` compile to identical bytes). Prefer **lowercase** keywords for BPE token efficiency unless matching an uppercase codebase; double-quoted strings (`"..."`) preserve exact wire casing.

3. **1 Statement = 1 Ethernet Frame & `wait` Timing**: Each directional statement (`a -> b <proto> ...` or `a <- b <proto> ...`) emits one frame. `wait <u32><ns|us|ms|s|m>` sets the pre-frame timestamp advance (default `10ms` when omitted; PCAPNG epoch starts at `1_700_000_000_000_000_000` ns with `IfTsResol(9)` $10^{-9}\text{ s}$ resolution; `frameassembly show` displays frame 1 at `0.000` ms).

4. **Stateful 4-Tuple TCP & Bidirectional Port Inheritance**: Canonical 4-tuple streams initialize `seq = 1000` on both peers (`win = 64240` default, ephemeral `srcport = 12345` default). `syn` and `fin` each advance `seq` by `+1`; payloads advance `seq` by exact payload byte length. TCP-based L7 statements automatically emit `psh ack` segments sharing 4-tuple `seq`/`acknum` state with raw `tcp` statements, and `<-` automatically swaps source/destination IPs, MACs, and ports.

5. **Dual-Stack Homogeneity & MAC Auto-Derivation**: A `flow` is reusable across IPv4 (`0x0800`) and IPv6 (`0x86DD`) host pairs, but mixing IPv4 and IPv6 hosts in the same statement is a semantic error. `mac` accepts colon (`00:1a:2b:3c:4d:5e`), hyphen (`00-1A-2B-3C-4D-5E`), and Cisco dotted-quad (`001a.2b3c.4d5e`) formats; when omitted, FrameAssembly derives RFC 1112 (`01:00:5e:xx:xx:xx`) IPv4 multicast MACs, RFC 2464 (`33:33:xx:xx:xx:xx`) IPv6 multicast MACs, IEEE 802.1D L2 group MACs, or `00:00:00:00:00:01` / `00:00:00:00:00:02` unicast defaults.

6. **Three-Way `.fasm` Format Disambiguation**: FrameAssembly `.fasm` (`text/vnd.frameassembly`, `//` comments, `host`/`flow`/`compile`, `->`/`<-`) is strictly distinct from x86 Flat Assembler (`;` comments, `format PE`/`ELF`, CPU mnemonics) and SymbiFlow/F4PGA FPGA FASM (`#` comments, tile bit paths).



**Anti-Hallucination & Cross-Protocol Syntax Guardrails**



| Construct | Invalid / Hallucinated Syntax (NEVER WRITE) | Canonical `.fasm` Syntax (ALWAYS WRITE) |

| :--- | :--- | :--- |

| **Comments** | `# comment`, `; comment`, or `/* block */` | `// single-line comment` |

| **Host Block** | `host c = { ipv4: "10.0.0.1", mask: 24 }` or `ipv6 ::1` | `host c { ip 10.0.0.1 mac 00:11:22:33:44:55 }` (`ip` for both v4 & v6) |

| **Flow Signature** | `flow web { from c to s send http }` | `flow web(c, s) { c -> s http get uri "/" }` |

| **Inter-Frame Delay** | `[+5ms] c -> s tcp ack` or standalone `wait 5ms` | `c -> s tcp ack wait 5ms` (inline modifier on packet statement) |

| **Ports & TCP Ack** | `sport 1234 dport 80 ack 100` | `srcport 1234 dstport 80 seq 1 acknum 100` (`ack` alone is the flag) |

| **TCP Flags** | `flags [syn, ack]` or `flags="SA"` | `tcp syn ack` (`syn ack fin rst psh urg ece cwr`) |

| **Hop Limit & QoS** | `hop_limit 64` or `tos 46` | `ttl 64 dscp 46 ecn 2` (`ttl 0..255`, `dscp 0..63`, `ecn 0..3`) |

| **VLAN & QinQ** | `vlan 0`, `qinq 100 200`, or `svlan 100 cvlan 200` | `vlan 100 pcp 5 dei 0` (`1..4094`) or `qinq 100 inner_vlan 200` |

| **HTTP & RTSP Hdrs** | `http get host "a.com"` or `rtsp setup transport "..."` | `http get uri "/" host_hdr "a.com"` / `rtsp setup transport_hdr "..."` |

| **BGP vs RIP Prefix** | `bgp update prefix 10.0.0.0/8` / `rip prefix "10.0.0.0/8"` | `bgp update prefix "10.0.0.0/8"` (quoted CIDR) / `rip prefix 10.0.0.0` (bare IP) |

| **DHCP vs DNS ID** | `dhcp discover txid 1` or `snmp2 get req_id 1` | `dhcp discover xid 1` (`txid` is for DNS/Modbus/STUN) / `snmp2 get reqid 1` |

| **IKEv2 & SNMPv3** | `ikev2 exchange auth` or `snmp3 auth "sha256" "pw"` | `ikev2 sa_init` (`create_child_sa`\|`informational`) / `snmp3 auth sha256 "pw"` |

| **Compile Block** | Omitted `compile`, two `compile` blocks, or `compile { f }` | Single `compile { f(h1, h2) loop 3 { f(h1, h2) } }` |



**Universal Cross-Layer Modifiers (Valid on Any Applicable Statement)**



- **Layer 2**: `srcmac <mac>`, `dstmac <mac>`, `ethertype <u16>`, `vlan <1..4094> [pcp <0..7>] [dei <0..1>]`, `qinq <1..4094> [inner_vlan <1..4094>]`, `mpls <0..1048575> [exp|tc <0..7>] [bos <0..1>] [mpls_ttl <u8>]`.

- **Layer 3**: `ttl <0..255>`, `dscp <0..63>`, `ecn <0..3>`, `flowlabel <0..1048575>`, `ipid <u16>`, `df`, `mf`, `fragoffset <0..8191>`, `next_header <u8>`.

- **Layer 4**: `srcport <u16>`, `dstport <u16>`, `transport <tcp|udp>` (switches dual-transport protocols: default-TCP `modbus`, `nfs`, `memcached`, `dnp3`, `ethernetip`; default-UDP `dns`, `sip`, `syslog`, `kerberos`), `seq <u32>`, `acknum <u32>`, `win|window <u16>`, `urgent <u16>`, `mss <u16>`, `wscale <u8>`, `sack_perm|sackperm`, `tsval <u32>`, `tsecr <u32>`, TCP flags (`syn`, `ack`, `fin`, `rst`, `psh`, `urg`, `ece`, `cwr`; note that inside `coap`, `dhcp`, `tftp`, and `sip`, `ack`/`rst` act as L7 message tokens).

- **Payload & Timing**: `payload "<escaped_utf8>"` (`\r`, `\n`, `\t`, `\\`, `\"`, `\xHH`, `\uXXXX`) OR `hexpayload "<even_hex>"` (mutually exclusive), `wait <u32><ns|us|ms|s|m>`.



**Complete 81-Protocol Zero-Default Syntax & Port Dictionary**



Every protocol compiles with **zero required sub-keywords**; optional protocol-scoped modifiers are listed below:



- **Layer 2 Switching & Data-Link (8)**:

  - `arp` (`0x0806` / IPv6 adapts to NDP): `[request|reply] [gratuitous|garp] [sha|sendermac <mac>] [spa|senderip <ip>] [tha|targetmac <mac>] [tpa|targetip <ip>]`

  - `vlan` (`0x8100`): `<1..4094> [pcp <0..7>] [dei <0..1>]`

  - `qinq` (`0x88A8`+`0x8100`): `<1..4094> [inner_vlan <1..4094>] [pcp <0..7>] [dei <0..1>]`

  - `lldp` (`0x88CC` -> `01:80:c2:00:00:0e`): `[chassis_id "<str>"] [port_id "<str>"|<u16>] [ttl <0..255>] [sysname "<str>"] [sysdesc "<str>"]`

  - `stp` (802.3 LLC `0x424203` -> `01:80:c2:00:00:00`): `[rstp] [root_id "<prio>/<mac>"] [bridge_id "<prio>/<mac>"] [port_id <u16>] [cost <u32>] [max_age <u16>] [hello_time <u16>] [forward_delay <u16>] [flags <u8>]`

  - `lacp` (`0x8809` -> `01:80:c2:00:00:02`): `[actor_sys <mac>] [actor_key <u16>] [actor_port <u16>] [actor_state <u8>] [partner_sys <mac>] [partner_key <u16>] [partner_port <u16>] [partner_state <u8>]`

  - `eapol` (`0x888E` -> `01:80:c2:00:00:03`): `[version <u8>] [[type] <eap_packet|start|logoff|key>] [eap_code <1..4>] [eap_id <u8>] [eap_method <u8>] [identity "<str>"]`

  - `mpls` (`0x8847`): `<0..1048575> [label <u32>] [exp|tc <0..7>] [bos <0..1>] [mpls_ttl <u8>]`

- **Layer 3 Control, Tunneling, VPN, Routing & FHRP (20)**:

  - `icmp` (IP `1` v4 / `58` v6): `[echo_request|echo_reply|dest_unreach|time_exceeded|redirect] [type <u8>] [code <u8>] [id <u16>] [seq <u32>] [gateway <ipv4>]`

  - `ndp` (IPv6 `58`, `ttl=255`): `[neighbor_solicit|neighbor_advert|router_solicit|router_advert] [target <ipv6>] [slla <mac>] [tlla <mac>] [router_lifetime <u16>]`

  - `igmp` (IPv4 `2`): `[query|report|leave] [v1|v2|v3|version <1..3>] [group <ipv4>] [max_resp <u8>]`

  - `mld` (IPv6 `58`): `[query|report|done] [multicast_addr <ipv6>] [max_resp_delay <u16>]`

  - `gre` (IP `47`): `[gre_key|key <u32>] [gre_seq <u32>] [gre_proto <u16>] [checksum]`

  - `vxlan` (UDP `4789`): `[vni|vnid <0..16777215>]`

  - `geneve` (UDP `6081`): `[vni|vnid <0..16777215>] [opt_class <u16>] [opt_type <u8>] [protocol_type <u16>]`

  - `ipsec` / `esp` (IP `50`): `[spi <u32>] [seq <u32>] [iv "<hex>"] [icv "<hex>"] [next_header <u8>]`

  - `ah` (IP `51`): `[spi <u32>] [seq <u32>] [icv "<hex>"] [next_header <u8>]`

  - `ikev2` (UDP `500`): `[[exchange] <sa_init|create_child_sa|informational>] [initiator_spi <u64>] [responder_spi <u64>] [msgid <u32>] [flags <u8>] [next_payload <u8>]`

  - `wireguard` (UDP `51820`): `[[type] <initiation|response|cookie|data>] [sender <u32>] [receiver <u32>] [counter <u64>]`

  - `ospf` (IP `89` -> `224.0.0.5`/`ff02::5`): `[hello|dbd|lsr|lsu|lsack] [router_id <ipv4>] [area_id <u32|ipv4>] [hello_interval <u16>] [dead_interval <u32>] [priority <u16>]`

  - `bgp` (TCP `179`): `[open|update|notification|keepalive] [asn <u32>] [holdtime <u16>] [bgpid <ipv4>] [prefix|nlri "<cidr>"] [nexthop <ip>]`

  - `rip` (UDP `520` v4 / `521` v6): `[request|response|reply] [prefix <ip>] [metric <1..16>] [nexthop <ip>] [tag <u16>]`

  - `pim` (IP `103` -> `224.0.0.13`/`ff02::d`): `[hello|join_prune|register] [group <ip>] [source <ip>] [rp <ip>] [holdtime <u16>] [dr_priority <u32>]`

  - `vrrp` (IP `112` -> `224.0.0.18`/`ff02::12`, `ttl=255`): `[vrid <1..255>] [priority <0..255>] [adv_int <u16>] [vip <ip>] [version <2|3>]`

  - `hsrp` (UDP `1985` v4 / `2029` v6): `[group <u8>] [priority <u16>] [state <u8>] [hellotime <u8>] [holdtime <u16>] [auth "<str>"] [vip <ip>]`

  - `bfd` (UDP `3784`): `[state <0..3>] [diag <0..31>] [my_disc <u32>] [your_disc <u32>] [min_tx <u32>] [min_rx <u32>] [mult <u8>]`

  - `openflow` (TCP `6653`): `[[type] <hello|echo_req|echo_request|echo_reply|features_req|features_reply|packet_in|packet_out|flow_mod>] [version <u8>] [xid <u32>] [dpid <u64>] [table_id <u8>] [priority <u16>]`

- **Layer 4 Transports (3)**:

  - `tcp` (IP `6`, default `dstport 80`): `[syn] [ack] [fin] [rst] [psh] [urg] [ece] [cwr] [seq <u32>] [acknum <u32>] [win|window <u16>] [urgent <u16>] [mss <u16>] [wscale <u8>] [sack_perm] [tsval <u32>] [tsecr <u32>]`

  - `udp` (IP `17`, default `dstport 80`): `[srcport <u16>] [dstport <u16>] [payload "<str>"|hexpayload "<hex>"]`

  - `sctp` (IP `132`, CRC32c LE): `[[chunk] <init|init_ack|cookie_echo|cookie_ack|data|sack|heartbeat|heartbeat_ack|shutdown|abort>] [vtag <u32>] [tsn <u32>] [stream <u16>] [ssn <u16>] [ppid <u32>]`

- **Layer 7 SNMP Network Management (3)** (`varbind <oid> <null|nullval | string "<str>" | int <i32> | timeticks <u32> | ipval <ip> | oidval <oid> | counter32 <u32> | gauge32 <u32> | counter64 <u64>>`):

  - `snmp1` (UDP `162` trap / `161` poll): `[trap|get|getnext|set|response] [community "<str>"] [enterprise <oid>] [oid <oid>] [agentip <ipv4>] [gentrap <0..6>] [spectrap <u32>] [sysuptime <u32>] [reqid <u32>] [varbind ...]` (no `getbulk`, `inform`, or `counter64`)

  - `snmp2` (UDP `162` trap,inform / `161` poll): `[trap|inform|get|getnext|getbulk|set|response] [community "<str>"] [reqid <u32>] [nonrepeaters <u32>] [maxrepetitions <u32>] [sysuptime <u32>] [oid <oid>] [varbind ...]`

  - `snmp3` (UDP `162` trap,inform / `161` poll): `[trap|inform|get|getnext|getbulk|set|response] [user "<str>"] [engineid "<even_hex>"] [engineboots <u32>] [enginetime <u32>] [contextname "<str>"] [auth <md5|sha|sha256|sha384|sha512> "<pass>"] [priv <des|aes> "<pass>"] [reqid <u32>] [nonrepeaters <u32>] [maxrepetitions <u32>] [sysuptime <u32>] [oid <oid>] [varbind ...]` (`priv` requires `auth`)

- **Layer 7 Infrastructure, Time, AAA & Telemetry (11)**:

  - `dns` (UDP/TCP `53`): `[query|response] [txid <u16>] [qname "<domain>"] [qtype "<type>"] [rdata "<val>"] [rcode <0..15>] [ans_ttl <u32>] [transport tcp]`

  - `mdns` (UDP `5353` -> `224.0.0.251`/`ff02::fb`): `[query|response] [txid <u16>] [qname "<domain>"] [qtype "<type>"] [rdata "<val>"] [rcode <0..15>] [ans_ttl <u32>]`

  - `dhcp` (UDP `68<->67` v4 / `546<->547` v6): `[discover|offer|request|ack|release|solicit|advertise|reply] [xid <u32>] [ciaddr <ipv4>] [yiaddr <ip>] [siaddr <ipv4>] [chaddr <mac>] [hostname "<str>"] [dns_server <ip>] [router <ipv4>] [subnet_mask <ipv4>] [lease_time <u32>]`

  - `ntp` (UDP `123`): `[li <0..3>] [vn <1..4>] [mode <0..7>] [stratum <0..16>] [poll <u8>] [precision <i32>] [refid "<4char>"] [tx_timestamp <u64>]`

  - `ptp` (UDP `319` sync,delay_req / `320` follow_up,delay_resp,announce): `[sync|delay_req|follow_up|delay_resp|announce|msg_type "<str>"] [domain <u8>] [seq_id <u16>] [clock_id "<str>"]`

  - `radius` (UDP `1812` auth / `1813` acct): `[access_request|access_accept|access_reject|access_challenge|accounting_request|accounting_response|code "<str>"] [id <u8>] [user "<str>"] [nas_ip <ip>] [service_type <u32>] [framed_ip <ip>]`

  - `tacacs` (TCP `49`): `[[type] <authen|author|acct>] [seq <u8>] [flags <u8>] [session_id <u32>] [user "<str>"] [data "<str>"]`

  - `syslog` (UDP/TCP `514`): `[facility <0..23>] [severity <0..7>] [pri <0..191>] [hostname "<str>"] [app "<str>"] [procid "<str>"] [msgid "<str>"] [msg "<str>"] [transport tcp]`

  - `netflow` (UDP `2055`): `[srcip <ipv4>] [dstip <ipv4>] [srcport <u16>] [dstport <u16>] [proto <u8>] [packets <u32>] [octets <u32>]`

  - `ipfix` (UDP `4739`): `[domain_id <u32>] [srcip <ipv4>] [dstip <ipv4>] [srcport <u16>] [dstport <u16>] [proto <u8>] [packets <u32>] [octets <u32>]`

  - `sflow` (UDP `6343`): `[agent_ip|agentip <ip>] [sub_agent_id <u32>] [seq <u32>] [uptime <u32>] [samples <u32>]`

- **Layer 7 Web, Cloud, Security, VoIP & Remote Access (16)**:

  - `http` (TCP `80`): `[get|post|put|delete|head|options|patch|method "<verb>"] [uri "<path>"] [version "<ver>"] [host_hdr "<host>"] [user_agent "<ua>"] [content_type "<mime>"] [header "<k>" "<v>"...] [status <u16>] [reason "<str>"] [body "<str>"]`

  - `http2` (TCP `443`): `[preface] [settings|headers|data|window_update|ping|goaway] [stream_id <u32>]`

  - `grpc` (TCP `50051`): `[service "<pkg.Svc>"] [method "<Rpc>"] [grpc_status <u32>]`

  - `websocket` (TCP `80`): `[text|binary|ping|pong|close|opcode "<str>"] [fin_bit <0|1>] [mask_key <u32>] [payload "<str>"]`

  - `tls` (TCP `443`): `[client_hello|server_hello|certificate|finished|app_data|alert] [record_version <u16>] [handshake_version <u16>] [sni "<host>"] [ciphersuite <u16>] [alpn "<proto>"]`

  - `quic` (UDP `443`): `[initial|zero_rtt|handshake|retry|short] [version <u32>] [dcid <u64|"<hex>">] [scid <u64|"<hex>">] [token "<str>"] [pkt_num <u32>]`

  - `ssh` (TCP `22`): `[banner "<str>"] [kexinit] [newkeys] [msg_code <u8>] [cookie "<hex>"]`

  - `telnet` (TCP `23`): `[will [option] <u8>] [wont [option] <u8>] [do [option] <u8>] [dont [option] <u8>] [option <u8>] [data "<str>"]`

  - `tftp` (UDP `69`): `[rrq|wrq|data|ack|err|error] [filename "<str>"] [mode "<str>"] [block <u16>] [errcode <u16>] [errmsg "<str>"]`

  - `ftp` (TCP `21`): `[cmd "<verb>"] [arg "<str>"] [code <u16>] [reply "<str>"]`

  - `whois` (TCP `43`): `[query|response] [domain "<str>"] [registrar "<str>"]`

  - `sip` (UDP/TCP `5060`): `[invite|ack|bye|cancel|register|options|method "<verb>"] [uri "<uri>"] [status <u16>] [reason "<str>"] [from "<uri>"] [to "<uri>"] [call_id "<id>"] [cseq <u32>] [via "<str>"] [contact "<uri>"] [content_type "<mime>"] [body "<sdp>"] [transport tcp]`

  - `rtp` (UDP `5004`): `[pt <0..127>] [seq <u16>] [timestamp <u32>] [ssrc <u32>] [marker <0|1>]`

  - `rtsp` (TCP `554`): `[options|describe|setup|play|teardown|method "<verb>"] [uri "<url>"] [status <u16>] [cseq <u32>] [transport_hdr "<str>"] [session "<id>"]`

  - `stun` (UDP `3478`): `[binding_request|binding_response|binding_error] [txid <u32>] [xor_mapped_addr <ip>] [software "<str>"]`

  - `ssdp` (UDP `1900`): `[msearch|notify] [host_hdr "<ip:port>"] [man "<str>"] [mx <u8>] [st "<str>"] [nt "<str>"] [nts "<str>"] [usn "<str>"] [location "<url>"]`

- **Layer 7 Mail, Identity, Storage, Databases, Caches & Brokers (14)**:

  - `smtp` (TCP `25`): `[ehlo ["<dom>"]|helo ["<dom>"]|mail_from ["<addr>"]|rcpt_to ["<addr>"]|quit|cmd "<verb>"] [param "<arg>"] [code <u16>] [reply "<str>"] [body "<mime>"]`

  - `imap` (TCP `143`): `[tag "<tag>"] [cmd "<verb>"] [arg "<str>"] [status "<OK|NO|BAD>"] [response "<str>"]`

  - `pop3` (TCP `110`): `[cmd "<verb>"] [arg "<str>"] [ok|err] [response "<str>"]`

  - `kerberos` (UDP/TCP `88`): `[as_req|as_rep|tgs_req|tgs_rep|krb_error] [realm "<REALM>"] [cname "<principal>"] [sname "<service>"] [etype <u32>] [transport tcp]`

  - `ldap` (TCP `389`): `[bind_req|bind_res|search_req|search_entry|search_done|unbind_req] [msgid <u32>] [base_dn "<dn>"] [filter "<expr>"] [result_code <u32>]`

  - `smb` (TCP `445`): `[negotiate|session_setup|tree_connect|create|tree_disconnect|command "<name>"] [status <u32>] [tree_id <u32>] [session_id <u64>] [msgid <u64>] [share "<unc>"] [filename "<name>"]`

  - `nfs` (TCP/UDP `2049`): `[compound|proc "<NULL|GETATTR|LOOKUP|READ|WRITE|COMPOUND>"] [vers <2|3|4>] [xid <u32>] [tag "<str>"] [path "<path>"] [transport udp]`

  - `redis` (TCP `6379`): `[get|set|cmd "<verb>"] [key "<key>"] [args "<arg>"...] [reply_type "<SIMPLE|ERROR|INTEGER|BULK>"] [value "<val>"]`

  - `memcached` (TCP/UDP `11211`): `[get|set|cmd "<verb>"] [key "<key>"] [value "<val>"] [flags <u32>] [exptime <u32>] [opcode <u8>] [opaque <u32>] [cas <u64>] [transport udp]`

  - `mysql` (TCP `3306`): `[greeting|login|query|ok|err|eof] [server_version "<ver>"] [user "<user>"] [db "<db>"] [sql "<sql>"] [errcode <u16>]`

  - `postgres` (TCP `5432`): `[startup|query|auth_ok|command_complete|ready_for_query|error_response] [user "<role>"] [db "<db>"] [sql "<sql>"]`

  - `mqtt` (TCP `1883`): `[connect|connack|publish|puback|subscribe|suback|pingreq|pingresp|disconnect|pkt_type "<type>"] [client_id "<id>"] [topic "<topic>"] [qos <0..2>] [retain [0|1]] [pkt_id <u16>] [keepalive <u16>] [return_code <u8>]`

  - `coap` (UDP `5683`): `[con|non|ack|rst|msg_type "<type>"] [get|post|put|delete|created|changed|not_found|code "<c.dd>"] [msgid <u16>] [token <u32|"<hex>">] [uri_path "<path>"] [content_format <u16>]`

  - `amqp` (TCP `5672`): `[protocol_header|connection_start|channel_open|basic_publish|basic_deliver|heartbeat] [channel <u16>] [exchange "<name>"] [routing_key "<key>"]`

- **Layer 7 Industrial Control Systems & SCADA/OT (6)**:

  - `modbus` (TCP/UDP `502`): `[read_coils|read_discrete_inputs|read_holding_registers|read_input_registers|write_single_coil|write_single_register|write_multiple_registers|func "<name>"] [txid <u16>] [proto_id <u16>] [unitid <u8>] [addr <u16>] [count <u16>] [value <u16>] [is_response] [transport udp]`

  - `bacnet` (UDP `47808`): `[who_is|i_am|read_property|write_property] [invoke_id <u8>] [object_type <u16>] [object_instance <u32>] [property_id <u32>] [value <u32>]`

  - `dnp3` (TCP/UDP `20000`, auto IEEE 1815 CRC-16): `[confirm|read|write|select|operate|direct_operate|unsolicited_response|func "<RESPONSE|...>"] [src <u16>] [dst <u16>] [group <u8>] [variation <u8>] [crc <u16>] [transport udp]`

  - `s7comm` (TCP `102`): `[setup_comm|read_var|write_var|plc_control|func "<name>"] [rosctr "<JOB|ACK|ACK_DATA|USERDATA>"] [pdu_ref <u16>] [area <u8|"<DB|MK|PE|PA|CT|TM>">] [db_num <u16>] [offset <u32>] [count <u16>]`

  - `ethernetip` (TCP/UDP `44818`): `[list_identity|list_services|list_interfaces|register_session|unregister_session|send_rr_data|send_unit_data|cmd "<NOP|...>"] [session_handle <u32>] [status <u32>] [context <u64>] [cip_service <u8>] [cip_class <u16>] [cip_instance <u16>] [cip_attr <u16>] [transport udp]`

  - `opcua` (TCP `4840`): `[msg_type "<HEL|ACK|OPN|CLO|MSG|ERR>"] [chunk_type "<F|C|A>"] [secure_channel_id <u32>] [token_id <u32>] [seq_num <u32>] [reqid <u32>] [endpoint_url "<url>"] [node_id "<id>"]`



**Canonical Compilable `.fasm` Template, CLI & Rust Library API**



```frameassembly

// Stateful TCP 3-way handshake, HTTP/1.1 health check, and encrypted SNMPv3 USM trap

host client { ip 10.0.0.10 mac 00:11:22:33:44:55 }

host server { ip 10.0.0.80 mac aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff }



flow demo_flow(c, s) {

    c -> s tcp syn srcport 51234 dstport 80 win 65535 mss 1460

    c <- s tcp syn ack win 65535 mss 1460 wait 1ms

    c -> s tcp ack wait 1ms

    c -> s http get uri "/health" host_hdr "api.internal" wait 5ms

    c <- s http status 200 reason "OK" body "{\"ok\":true}" wait 2ms

    s -> c vlan 100 snmp3 trap user "admin" engineid "80001f8880112233" auth sha256 "authpass123" priv aes "privpass123" oid 1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.5.4 varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.5.0 string "srv01" wait 5ms

}



compile {

    demo_flow(client, server)

}

```



- **CLI, Dissection & Replay**:

  - Preview terminal packet ladder without writing a file: `frameassembly show demo.fasm`

  - Compile to `.pcap` / `.pcapng`: `frameassembly demo.fasm -o demo.pcap`

  - Inspect & replay: `tshark -r demo.pcap -V` / `sudo tcpreplay -i eth0 demo.pcap` / `suricata -r demo.pcap -k none` / `zeek -C -r demo.pcap`

- **Installation**:

  - Linux / macOS bootstrap: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/install.sh | sh`

  - Homebrew: `brew install SteveWinschel/tap-FrameAssembly/frameassembly`

  - WinGet / Scoop: `winget install SteveWinschel.FrameAssembly` / `scoop bucket add frameassembly https://github.com/SteveWinschel/homebrew-tap-FrameAssembly && scoop install frameassembly`

  - Cargo / NPM WASM / VS Code: `cargo install frameassembly` / `npm install frameassembly-wasm` / `code --install-extension SteveWinschel.frameassembly-vscode`

- **Public Rust Library Signatures (`frameassembly` v1.4.5)**:

  - `frameassembly::lexer::lex<'a>(input: &'a str) -> Result<Vec<(Token<'a>, std::ops::Range<usize>)>, CompilerError>`

  - `frameassembly::parser::parse_program<'a>(input_str: &'a str) -> Result<Program<'a>, CompilerError>` (lexes, parses, and runs `validate_semantics`)

  - `frameassembly::parser::validate_semantics(program: &Program, src: &str) -> Result<(), CompilerError>`

  - `frameassembly::backend::compile_program(program: &Program) -> Result<Vec<(Vec<u8>, u64)>, String>` (returns `(ethernet_frame_bytes, timestamp_ns)`)

  - `frameassembly::backend::generate_pcap(program: &Program, output_path: &str) -> Result<(), String>`

  - `frameassembly::error::CompilerError`: `LexError { src: String, span: (usize, usize) }`, `ParseError { message: String, src: String, span: (usize, usize) }`, `SemanticError { message: String, src: String, span: (usize, usize) }`, `BackendError(String)`



## Core Documentation



- [README — Overview, Use Cases & Comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/README.md): Problems solved, SNMPv3/IDS/firewall examples, comparison vs Scapy/text2pcap/Ostinato, and CLI quickstart.

- [Getting Started Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/docs/getting_started.md): Beginner walkthrough of `host`/`flow`/`compile`, defaults vs overrides, stateful TCP tracking, MAC notations, and Wireshark cheat sheet.

- [Practical Use-Case Cookbook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/docs/use_cases.md): Copy-paste `.fasm` recipes for SNMPv1/v2c/v3 traps, DMZ firewall audits, PMTUD/fragmentation, VLAN/QinQ/MPLS QoS, SIEM/IDS ingest, and OT conduits.

- [Layer 2 Switching & Data-Link Protocols](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/docs/l2_protocols.md): Wire framing, bitmasks, and examples for `arp`, `vlan`, `qinq`, `lldp`, `stp`, `lacp`, `eapol`, and `mpls`.

- [Layer 3 Control, Tunneling, VPN & Routing Protocols](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/docs/l3_protocols.md): Reference for IPv4/IPv6 modifiers, `icmp`, `ndp`, `igmp`, `mld`, `gre`, `vxlan`, `geneve`, `ikev2`, `ipsec`/`esp`/`ah`, `wireguard`, `ospf`, `bgp`, `rip`, `pim`, `vrrp`, `hsrp`, `bfd`, and `openflow`.

- [Layer 4 Transport Protocols](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/docs/l4_transports.md): 4-tuple state tracking, RFC 7323 TCP options, UDP checksum rules, dual-transport switching, and SCTP CRC32c / telecom `PPID` reference.

- [Layer 7 SNMPv1, SNMPv2c & SNMPv3 USM](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/docs/l7_snmp.md): ASN.1 BER encoding, `snmp1`/`snmp2`/`snmp3`, all 9 `varbind` types, MIB-II OIDs, USM `SHA-2`/`AES`/`DES` crypto, and `tshark` decryption.

- [Layer 7 Infrastructure, Time, AAA & Flow Telemetry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/docs/l7_infra_and_telemetry.md): Reference for `dns`, `mdns`, `dhcp`, `ntp`, `ptp`, `radius`, `tacacs`, `syslog`, `netflow`, `ipfix`, and `sflow`.

- [Layer 7 Web, Cloud-Native, Security, VoIP & Remote Access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/docs/l7_web_and_cloud.md): Reference for `http`, `http2`, `grpc`, `websocket`, `tls`, `quic`, `ssh`, `telnet`, `tftp`, `ftp`, `whois`, `sip`, `rtp`, `rtsp`, `stun`, and `ssdp`.

- [Layer 7 Mail, Directory, Storage, Databases & Brokers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/docs/l7_mail_auth_storage_db.md): Reference for `smtp`, `imap`, `pop3`, `kerberos`, `ldap`, `smb`, `nfs`, `redis`, `memcached`, `mysql`, `postgres`, `mqtt`, `coap`, and `amqp`.

- [Layer 7 Industrial Control Systems (ICS) & SCADA/OT](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/docs/l7_industrial_ot.md): Reference for `modbus`, `bacnet`, `dnp3`, `s7comm`, `ethernetip`, and `opcua`.

- [Multi-Host Topologies & Dual-Stack Architectures](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/docs/topologies_and_dual_stack.md): EVPN-VXLAN Leaf-Spine, Campus 802.1X NAC, Dual-Stack Kubernetes Service Mesh, Carrier MPLS/IPsec WAN, and IEC 62443 OT conduits.

- [`.fasm` File Format & Media Type Specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/docs/fasm-specification.md): Normative RFC 6838 specification for `text/vnd.frameassembly`, UTF-8 rules, magic sniffing, and three-way `.fasm` disambiguation.

- [For Nerds: Compiler Pipeline, Rust API & Formal Grammars](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/docs/for_nerds.md): Six-stage zero-copy Rust compiler internals, public Rust library API, EBNF/GBNF/Lark constrained decoding, and RLVR reward design.



## Formal Grammars & Full LLM Context



- [Full Single-Fetch LLM Context Reference (`llms-full.txt`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/llms-full.txt): Deduplicated, KV-cache-optimized complete technical reference covering all 81 protocols, Rust APIs, formal EBNF grammar, and production topologies.

- [ISO/IEC 14977 EBNF Grammar (`grammar.ebnf`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/grammar.ebnf): Canonical context-free grammar covering all 81 protocols and 640+ lexer keywords.

- [GGML BNF Constrained Decoding Grammar (`frameassembly.gbnf`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/frameassembly.gbnf): Constrained decoding grammar (`root ::= ...`) for `llama.cpp`, `MLC-LLM`, and `XGrammar`.

- [Lark Earley/LALR Grammar (`frameassembly.lark`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/frameassembly.lark): Context-free grammar (`start: ...`) for `Outlines`, `vLLM`, `SGLang`, `Guidance`, and `llguidance`.



## Rust Compiler & Ecosystem Packages



- [Crate Root (`src/lib.rs`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/src/lib.rs): Public Rust API exports, 81-protocol matrix, and in-memory compilation quickstart.

- [Compiler Diagnostics (`src/error.rs`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/src/error.rs): `CompilerError` (`LexError`, `ParseError`, `SemanticError`, `BackendError`), plain-English hints, and foreign `.fasm` detection.

- [Zero-Copy Lexer (`src/lexer/mod.rs`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/src/lexer/mod.rs): `logos 0.14` DFA tokenizer for all 640+ case-insensitive keywords, time units, IPs, MACs, and OIDs.

- [AST Specifications (`src/ast/mod.rs`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/src/ast/mod.rs): Zero-copy `Program`, `HostDef`, `FlowDef`, `FrameStatement`, and `src/ast/{l2,l3,l4,l7}/` `*Spec` types.

- [Combinator Parser & Validator (`src/parser/mod.rs`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/src/parser/mod.rs): `winnow 1.0` token-slice parser, protocol-scoped modifier dispatch (`fields.rs`), and `validate_semantics` (`validation.rs`).

- [Stateful 4-Tuple Backend (`src/backend/mod.rs`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/src/backend/mod.rs): Flow evaluation, `loop` unrolling, two-stage port inheritance, 4-tuple TCP state machine, and multicast MAC derivation.

- [Wire Framing & Checksums (`src/packet.rs`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/src/packet.rs): Ethernet/VLAN/QinQ/MPLS, IPv4/IPv6, TCP/UDP wire builders, and disjoint-slice RFC 1071 checksums.

- [PCAPNG Writer (`src/pcap.rs`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/src/pcap.rs): Nanosecond-resolution `PcapWriter` (`LINKTYPE_ETHERNET`, `IfTsResol(9)`) over `pcap-file 2.0`.

- [API Documentation (`docs.rs/frameassembly`)](https://docs.rs/frameassembly): Hosted Rustdoc documentation for all public modules and `*Spec` AST structures.

- [WebAssembly Package (`npmjs.com/package/frameassembly-wasm`)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/frameassembly-wasm): Browser and Node.js WebAssembly bindings for `.fasm` validation and `.pcap` synthesis.



## Verified Reference Examples



- [Canonical Showcase (`demo.fasm`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/demo.fasm): End-to-end TCP handshake, HTTP/1.1 transaction, and SNMPv3 USM `SHA-256` + `AES-128` trap.

- [Omnibus Token Reference (`complete_dsl_omnibus_reference.fasm`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/examples/topologies/complete_dsl_omnibus_reference.fasm): Topology exercising TCP flags, UDP, and SNMPv1/v2c/v3 USM authentication/privacy algorithms.

- [Dual-Stack Polymorphic Flow (`dual_stack_polymorphic_flow_basic.fasm`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/examples/topologies/dual_stack_polymorphic_flow_basic.fasm): Single parameterized flow compiled across both IPv4 and IPv6 endpoint pairs.
